title: Introduce inflight-request quarantine and backpressure telemetry hotfix
author: Maya Singh
description:
Motivation: a recent regional surge incident (INC-2026-03-01-01) exposed a window where partially-served long-running requests amplified tail latency and triggered cascading node-level evictions. This PR introduces a short-lived 'inflight-request quarantine' state for requests that are selected for graceful backpressure during regional SLO violations and adds targeted telemetry to make quarantine behavior observable.

What this PR does: 1) runtime: marks selected in-flight requests as quarantined, preventing partial KV-cache flushes and ensuring either graceful completion or deterministic early-reject; 2) scheduler: introduces a quarantine-aware backpressure token so the load-trimmer can exclude quarantined inflight ops from aggressive preemption; 3) gateway: adds a 409 early-reject path for requests exceeding quarantine TTL to avoid indefinite resource holds; 4) telemetry: emits three new metrics and two audit log events to help correlate quarantines with downstream evictions and tenant SLO impact.

Design decisions: quarantine TTL is conservative (default 2s) and configurable via runtime flags; quarantine is applied only when regional SLO controller sets the region into 'soft-throttle' to avoid impact during normal operation; quarantine state is ephemeral and not persisted across node restarts. This is intentionally lightweight to fix the immediate incident vector with minimal rollout risk.

Checklist: - [x] add runtime state and token plumbing - [x] add gateway early-reject path and explicit HTTP 409 mapping - [x] add metrics and audit events - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration test in canary harness - [x] performance regression <1% on p95 in synthetic load tests

Notes: initial CI run uncovered a flaky test in scheduler/eviction_test which was fixed in a follow-up commit (remove nil race). All checks green on final run. Merge method: squash.
commits: b3f6a2e: runtime: add InflightQuarantine token and API (atomic state + TTL)
9c1d4ab: scheduler: honor InflightQuarantine when computing eviction candidates
4e7f0d3: gateway: early-reject path (HTTP 409) and mapping in proxy layer
a1e9bd2: telemetry: emit service.inflight_quarantine.count and audit events
c2d5f9a: tests: add unit tests for quarantine lifecycle and integration canary test

review_comments: Alina Perez (review): please ensure the TTL flag has a safe default and an env var override for private deployments - otherwise LGTM.
Maya Singh (author): added runtime_flags.yaml and documented the env override; default TTL set to 2000ms, configurable via REDWOOD_INFLIGHT_QUARANTINE_TTL_MS.
Erik Thompson (review): gateway early-reject maps to 409; confirm clients treat 409 as retryable with backoff. Consider adding guidance to SDKs.
Maya Singh (author): added SDK guidance note to docs/operations/quarantine.md and marked early-reject as retryable with exponential backoff (recommended).
Samir Desai (approval): validated canary runs against a tenant-replay trace and saw quarantined_count correlate with reduced eviction churn. Approving.
release_notes: Hotfix: Introduces inflight-request quarantine to reduce cascading evictions during regional soft-throttle events. Adds telemetry (service.inflight_quarantine.count, service.quarantine.reject_rate, scheduler.quarantine.duration_ms) and an HTTP 409 early-reject path. Configurable via REDWOOD_INFLIGHT_QUARANTINE_TTL_MS.
body_short: Adds short-lived in-flight quarantine state plus telemetry and an early-reject path to mitigate post-surge eviction cascades.
testing: unit: quarantine lifecycle and race tests (runtime)
integration: gateway + scheduler canary against tenant-replay trace
perf: synthetic p95/p99 regression tests (<1% p95 change)
staging: 5% canary for 4 hours with litmus tenant workloads
rollout_plan: Canary 5% (2 regions) for 4h -> monitor service.inflight_quarantine.count, eviction_rate, p99 latency -> expand to 25% for 2h -> full rollout if metrics stable. Rollback: flip runtime flag to disable quarantine immediately.
motivation_tagline: Prevent partial in-flight work from amplifying regional evictions during soft-throttle windows.
